description.zh: 指定要操作的签名密钥id

指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**: the production environment

- **PRE**: the staging environment

- **TEST**: the testing environment

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-signature-apis --signature-id 9242e31589fc41f4ba15dd52ffa2ce61 --group-id b1eed5faa2404af4945cca26d611a136 --api-ids 7ce7022b23a340c7becd947487fad84c --stage-name RELEASE --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
